Creating projection_object

Source: R/Loader.R
create_projection_object.Rd

Function for creating a projection object used in the MRC projection model. Users can specify several parameters controlling the projection setup, inclusion of migration and switching processes, and assumptions regarding fertility differentials.

Usage

create_projection_object(
  name,
  country_object_list,
  region_object_list,
  steps = 10,
  migration = TRUE,
  switching = TRUE,
  switching_type = 1,
  no_diff = FALSE,
  post_switch = FALSE,
  light_migration = TRUE,
  light_switching = TRUE
)

Arguments

name

Character; name of the projection scenario - required.

country_object_list

List; country objects created by `create_country_list()`. If omitted or not a list, `create_country_list(post_switch = post_switch)` is called automatically. The same list cannot be reused across multiple projections (no default - auto-created if missing).

region_object_list

List; region objects created by `create_region_list()`. If omitted or not a list, `create_region_list()` is called automatically. Modify only if you are fully familiar with the internal structure of the package (no default - auto-created if missing).

steps

Numeric; number of 5-year projection periods to simulate (default 10).

migration

Logical; whether migration (emigration and immigration) is included in the projection (default TRUE).

switching

Logical; whether religious switching is included in the projection (default TRUE).

switching_type

Numeric; sequence of switching relative to demographic processes. Available options: 1 - The population is divided into two groups. For the first group, switching rates are applied at the beginning of the period (before demographic processes); for the second group, switching occurs at the end of the period (after demographic processes). 2 - Switching is applied entirely at the beginning of the period, before demographic processes. (Default = 1).

no_diff

Logical; if TRUE, fertility differentials by religion are ignored and all religions use the total ASFR (default FALSE - differentials are applied).

post_switch

Logical; controls how religious switching is tracked across periods. If FALSE (default), individuals who have switched religion remain in the general population and may switch again in subsequent steps. If TRUE, those who have switched are moved into separate post-switch columns and excluded from further switching. Also forwarded to `create_country_list()` when called automatically.

light_migration

Logical; if TRUE, migration output is stored in abbreviated form to reduce memory usage. Recommended when running multiple projections (default TRUE).

light_switching

Logical; if TRUE, switching output is stored in abbreviated form to reduce memory usage. Recommended when running multiple projections (default TRUE).

Value

A single projection object

See also

create_country_list to create the required country list, variants_loader to validate this object before projecting, project to run the projection, save_csv_all and save_plots_all to export results. vignette("conducting-projections") for a full walkthrough.

Examples

test_po <- create_projection_object(name = "test", steps = 5)
